**Gross Margin Calculation for Microsoft FY2024 (fiscal year ended June 30, 2024):**

Per Microsoft's FY2024 10-K, revenue was $245,122 million and cost of revenue was $74,114 million [DOC-1].

Gross profit = $245,122M − $74,114M = $171,008 million

Gross margin (%) = $171,008M / $245,122M ≈ 69.76%

Note: These figures are drawn from a single fiscal year (FY2024) within the same filing and accounting basis, so no comparability adjustments are needed for this calculation. (The document also includes FY2023 comparatives, but those were not used here since the question asks specifically about FY2024.)

ANSWER: Gross profit of $171,008 million, representing a gross margin of approximately 69.8% of revenue.
